name: cards
description: Friendly UI-card system: slides alternate light blue tint / near-black / off-white with full brand-blue fills, Manrope ExtraBold sentence-case headlines top-left, content in big-radius rounded panels (list rows as stacked cards with a round number chip and an arrow chip, the quote as a chat-bubble thread, the stat as a big number in a blue panel), mono labels in pills, a rounded pill button with an icon disc, small sparkles and a dark wave along the bottom of the cover and CTA.
source: Template photos themes/cards/refs/ref-1.png (health clinic grid) and ref-10.png (delivery brand grid), translated into the Alloy palette, October 2026. See notes.md.
best_for: how-to and process posts (steps as cards)

options.rhythm: Odd slides are light (blue-200 tint; every 4n+3 off-white), even slides near-black, quote is full brand blue (fill_types). Cover and CTA are always tint with the dark wave. Set "fill": true on any slide to make it full blue.
variant: (none: the renderer gives CSS no mode/variant class, so a mono variant can't switch the rhythm; see notes.md)
